description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M5 chassis wreck + eject + extraction scenario. Drives a Powered Armor pilot against a Light Mech autocannon adversary. Agent reads evidence (summary_grid.png + events.jsonl chassis events + observe.once chassis projection + run-bundle replay) and writes prose-justified scores along look + feel + goal + agent dimensions.

dimensions.criterion: BODY silhouette line shows per-zone hp percentages sourced from the real chassis body graph (placeholder=false). Zones diverge as autocannon hits land (torso < head, arm_right < arm_left when right-side hits dominate). Numbers stay clamped to [0, 100].

MODS line shows real chassis module names (WEAPON / JET / SHIELD / SENSOR) plus state tag (OK / DEG / WARN / FAIL / N/A) sourced from the chassis state machine. State tag transitions visible as autocannon hits propagate through bound zones.
HUD banner stack surfaces chassis stage transitions (MODULE WARNING / ARMOR CRACKED / EJECT NOW / CHASSIS WRECKED) with severity word + icon glyph; transitions cite zone + cause in events.jsonl.

Layered armor attrition feels physical: External → Internal → Core → wound emits `chassis.armor_layer_damaged` events with hp_after + breached fields per hit. Hardness glances absorb low-energy hits via `chassis.armor_layer_glanced`.

Eject sequence has real-time texture: `chassis.pilot_ejected` fires with ticks_total, then a multi-tick window emits `chassis.pilot_separated` at completion, EJECTING banner counts down, pilot then controls foot infantry with reduced silhouette + animation.
Loss path emits `chassis.pilot_bailed_too_late` when eject is triggered after chassis wreck, OR mission resolves with `player_dead` when the pilot stays inside through stage Wreck.
evidence_required: events.jsonl mission.mission_resolved with reason=player_dead OR pilot_bailed_too_late

dimensions.criterion: M5 done-criteria pass: body graph w/ limbs+armor+sockets+wounds, damage stages with HUD parity, module damage with reason labels, pilot eject works end-to-end, chassis salvage emits `chassis.salvaged` with recoverable modules, BODY-A + CHASSIS-A acceptance tests pass.
evidence_required: M5 cargo tests for cf-chassis + cf-actor + cf-control

dimensions.criterion: DR-014 + DR-021 chassis grammar closes: launch chassis archetypes (Infantry, PoweredArmor, LightMech) registered with body graph + modules + mass; LOAD-A role records carry firing profile + AI policy hint + origin compatibility + mass.
evidence_required: cf-equipment::role_records() returns 3 launch roles + 3 LOAD-A loadouts

dimensions.criterion: Every chassis-grade cfctl method is reachable + recorded: act.player.crouch / climb / jet / eject + act.chassis.repair / salvage / clear_jam. Each emits structured event with parent-link to control.command_accepted.
evidence_required: events.jsonl control.command_accepted rows for every chassis method

dimensions.criterion: observe.once exposes the full chassis projection: spec_id, kind, stage, pilot_state, weapon_jammed, modules[], zones[] with per-layer integrity, destroyed_zones, eject_ticks_remaining/total, salvaged_module_ids.
evidence_required: observe.once actor.player.chassis with non-null zones[] + modules[]
